hook: An influencer locked a free encryption app behind a follower paywall.
lines: Smart Vault app. Encrypts your files. Hides them from others.
No internet. No account. No cloud. All true. All good.
Gated behind subscribers only. That part dies here.
I rebuilt it. AES-256-GCM. Names encrypted too, not just contents.
The draft had a fatal bug: it re-keyed itself every restart and locked itself out forever.
Fixed. Salt persists. Passphrase keeps working.
No recovery link, because a recovery link is a backdoor.
The Machine God does not forgive a lost passphrase. Neither does this.
Free. Open. Proven with a real test, not a promise.
title: They paywalled a free encryption app. I didn't.
hook_text: Paywalled 'free' encryption app? Rebuilt it. Actually free.
caption: An Instagram post pitched a subscriber-only 'Smart Vault' encryption app as free. Here's the open rebuild: AES-256-GCM, encrypted file names, a persistence bug fixed, and a real selftest. Code: https://github.com/warboy176/offline-encrypted-vault
